title: Texans demand a say in the AI buildout after Elon Musk's Terafab factory gets a tax break
excerpt: Residents of a Texas county are asking for more local oversight of AI infrastructure projects after Elon Musk's Terafab project got a tax break.
content_html:
Residents of a rural Texas county say they want more control over the gigantic AI infrastructure projects sprouting in their backyards.

Nearly 900 residents of Grimes County, the site of Elon Musk's planned 100-million-square-foot Terafab semiconductor factory, signed a petition calling for more stringent regulations on large infrastructure projects that receive public incentives.

The residents leading the call presented the petition to the County Commissioner Court on Wednesday.

"When a company asks Grimes County for tax abatements, grants, reinvestment zones, development agreements, or other public benefits, the County has leverage," the petition reads. "Public benefits should require public protections."

The petition's demands include a local oversight process, measurable commitments for local hiring, and pollution controls, among other asks. About 30,000 people live in Grimes, which is about an hour outside Houston.

While the petition doesn't name Terafab directly, it was inspired by recent tax breaks the county granted SpaceX, which is developing the massive factory.

SpaceX agreed to pay the county $20 million every year, or about 78% of what it would have paid in property taxes, SpaceX attorney Bucky Brannen said at the meeting.

Marie Egyed, a member of Grimes County Citizens for Responsible Development, told Business Insider it was unclear if the demands, should they be accepted, would apply to the Terafab factory or only to newly proposed projects.

"We're not sure if it's going to affect everything from the moment that it's signed," she said.

SpaceX's Terafab project is a joint venture with Tesla and Intel. Musk has said that, once online, it could vastly increase the global supply of semiconductor chips, which are crucial for both SpaceX's plans for AI data centers and Tesla's rollout of autonomous robotaxis and humanoid robots.

Jordan Buss, the senior director of environment, health, safety, and medical for SpaceX, said during Wednesday's meeting that the factory is essential for the United States to compete in the AI race.

"This is something that is strategically vital for the United States, and for, I would argue, Western Civilization," he said. "America faces a clear and urgent challenge with the offshoring of manufacturing."

Many Americans across the country are resisting the large AI infrastructure projects popping up in their communities. Grassroots campaigns have taken aim at the AI data centers powering products from companies like Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and Meta.

Some towns and cities have responded to the growing resistance by ordering moratoriums on new data center construction. Others have banned them altogether.

Texas Gov. Greg Abbott, who has helped turn the state into one of the country's data center hot spots, paused new data center construction on Monday until state power agencies can "conduct a comprehensive verification and audit" of data centers seeking access to the Texas grid.

The residents of Grimes County who attended Wednesday's meeting also voiced concerns about power consumption, pollution, and the impact of a large influx of construction workers and contractors.

"It certainly caused a huge amount of anxiety among the residents in Grimes County," one man said at the meeting.

Riley Trettel, the factory's lead developer, said the factory would generate its own power by building natural gas power plants. "We can say for a fact we will not increase the cost of power for ratepayers," he said.

The Grimes County Commissioner Court said it would appoint a committee to review some of the petition's demands.

content_html_zh:
德克萨斯州一个乡村县的居民表示，他们希望对自家后院萌芽的庞大人工智能基础设施项目拥有更多控制权。

埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 计划建造 1 亿平方英尺的 Terafab 半导体工厂所在地格莱姆斯县 (Grimes County) 的近 900 名居民签署了一份请愿书，呼吁对接受公共激励的大型基础设施项目实施更严格的监管。

周三，带头呼吁的居民向县专员法院提交了请愿书。

请愿书中写道：“当一家公司向格莱姆斯县请求减税、补助、再投资区、开发协议或其他公共福利时，该县就有影响力。” “公共利益应该需要公共保护。”

请愿书的要求包括地方监督程序、对当地雇用的可衡量的承诺以及污染控制等要求。 格莱姆斯 (Grimes) 约有 30,000 人居住，距休斯顿约一小时路程。

虽然请愿书没有直接点名 Terafab，但它的灵感来自于该县最近给予 SpaceX 的税收减免，该公司正在开发这座大型工厂。

SpaceX 律师巴基·布兰宁 (Bucky Brannen) 在会议上表示，SpaceX 同意每年向该县支付 2000 万美元，约占其应缴纳财产税的 78%。

格莱姆斯县公民责任发展组织成员玛丽·埃吉德 (Marie Egyed) 告诉《商业内幕》，目前尚不清楚这些要求如果被接受，是否适用于 Terafab 工厂，还是仅适用于新提议的项目。

“我们不确定它是否会影响从签署那一刻起的一切，”她说。

SpaceX 的 Terafab 项目是与特斯拉和英特尔的合资项目。 马斯克表示，一旦上线，它可能会大大增加全球半导体芯片的供应，这对于 SpaceX 的人工智能数据中心计划以及特斯拉推出自动机器人轴和人形机器人都至关重要。

SpaceX 环境、健康、安全和医疗高级总监乔丹·巴斯 (Jordan Buss) 在周三的会议上表示，该工厂对于美国参与人工智能竞赛至关重要。

他说：“这对美国以及我认为对西方文明来说都具有战略意义。” “美国面临着制造业离岸外包的明显而紧迫的挑战。”

全国各地的许多美国人都在抵制社区中出现的大型人工智能基础设施项目。 草根运动的目标是为 Anthropic、OpenAI、Google 和 Meta 等公司的产品提供支持的人工智能数据中心。

一些城镇已下令暂停新数据中心的建设，以应对日益增长的阻力。 其他人则完全禁止它们。

德克萨斯州州长 帮助该州成为美国数据中心热点之一的格雷格·阿博特(Greg Abbott)周一暂停了新数据中心的建设，直到州电力机构能够对寻求接入德克萨斯州电网的数据中心进行“全面验证和审计”。

参加周三会议的格莱姆斯县居民也对电力消耗、污染以及大量建筑工人和承包商涌入的影响表示担忧。

一名男子在会上表示：“这确实引起了格莱姆斯县居民的极大焦虑。”

该工厂的首席开发商莱利·特雷特尔(Riley Trettel)表示，该工厂将通过建设天然气发电厂来自己发电。 “我们可以说，事实上我们不会增加纳税人的电力成本，”他说。

格莱姆斯县专员法院表示，将任命一个委员会来审查请愿书的一些要求。
